incident-bot: :rotating_light: Synthetic monitor alert: search-index-availability-synthetic exceeded latency threshold (5m p95 = 1.35s) — probe id: synth-search-eu-1
Maya: grabbing this, oncall-1 here. checking dashboards now.
Liam: I see the spike on the synthetic view — looks like short-lived blips across eu regions. no error-rate increase in prod traces yet.
Sophia: pinging infra for any infra toil? might be noisy probe artefact.
Jorge: FYI customer-facing APIs (search API) p95 also up ~200ms for a subset of traffic per sampling, but error rate stable. likely latency-only.
Maya: ok, immediate mitigation: mute pager for this synthetic monitor for 30m while we validate. adding a suppression tag.
Maya: @Liam can you confirm we can mute without losing critical coverage?
Liam: yes — synth is non-SLO probe used for early-warning only. suppression ok after we: 1) increase debounce to require 3 consecutive failures 2) temporarily raise p95 threshold to 1.5s
Sophia: linking the runbook: <https://redwood-internal/runbooks/synth-monitors> — follow monitoring playbook section "debounce & thresholds"
monitoring-bot: action recorded: mute applied to synth-search-eu-1 by Maya. mute_expires=2155010500.
Maya: quick config patch I'm proposing:
```
monitor: synth-search-eu-1
  frequency: 60s -> 180s
  failure_window: 1 -> 3
  threshold_p95: 1.2s -> 1.5s (temporary)
  alert_policy: mute-pager if (consecutive_failures < 3)
```
Liam: that looks good. increasing frequency will reduce signal-to-noise. also suggest enabling rolling-median smoothing (window=5) to avoid single-sample spikes.
Jorge: can we also add a segmentation to the monitor so it only alerts on client-facing endpoint path /v1/search and not internal health-checks? those internal calls skew the distribution.
Maya: good call. I'll update monitor to scope to path=/v1/search.
Sophia: customer impact note: current telemetry shows ~4% of search traffic in eu hit >300ms extra latency during the spike window, only for long queries. no retries or 5xx observed. marking as "degraded latency" not outage.
Maya: creating incident tracking ticket for post-incident follow-up: INC-2155. action items: a) update monitor config (freq,debounce,segmentation) b) add a dashboard pane for synth vs real-user p95 overlay c) schedule blameless review in 48h.
Maya: ticket body snippet:
```
INC-2155
summary: transient synthetic latency noise causing noisy alerts; scoped to eu synth monitor
impact: elevated p95 on synth probes, minor real-user latency bump for subset, no errors
actions:
  - update synth-search-eu-1 config (freq->180s, failure_window->3, smoothing->median5)
  - scope monitor to /v1/search
  - create dashboard overlay (synth p95 vs real-user p95, region filter)
  - evaluate probe placement and sampling
owner: Maya -> handoff to Platform SRE for follow-up
```
Liam: I'll push the config change and create the dashboard PR. tagging @Jorge for query review.
Jorge: will review the query. propose adding a synthetic tag indicating "path_filtered" for future alert differentiation.
monitoring-bot: config change applied: frequency=180s, failure_window=3, smoothing=median(5). scope updated to path=/v1/search. change_author=Liam.
Maya: thanks. unmuting pager early to verify recurrence window now that changes are live.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: No further alerts from synth-search-eu-1 in the next 10m.
Sophia: logging customer-impact summary into INC-2155 and notifying CS for any downstream tickets.
Maya: handoff note for next on-call: monitor now uses 180s sampling and 3-failure debounce. if alerts recur, escalate to Platform SRE and add trace IDs to the incident ticket.
Liam: created dashboard PR: https://git.internal/dashboards/PR-3423 — includes overlay and annotation layer for synthetic changes.
Jorge: approved PR comments, small tweak to the aggregation window.
Maya: follow-up action: evaluate moving this probe to a different vantage point (not directly on host with scheduled GC that lines up with probe cadence). adding to INC-2155 backlog.
Sophia: thanks team. closing this thread after postmortem notes in ticket. :slightly_smiling_face:
Liam: closing oncall handoff — next oncall: Eduardo at 2155080000.
monitoring-bot: incident INC-2155 created and linked to thread.
